title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: alert frequency and email recipients per policy (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, existing alert behaviour, licensing and permissions are supported. The planned settings remain undocumented; the existing alert-policy route needs only the Actions column added for completeness.
